cases.query: What has to happen before staff can go back inside?

sources.text: Facilities directive for the evacuated atrium: reoccupancy requires a clearance reading from the hygienist.
Evacuated atrium personnel will assemble at the south loading bay for a headcount.

cases.query: If I stop paying for my membership, do I lose the money I've already put aside?

sources.text: Meridian wallet terms: ending a subscription leaves the accumulated prepaid balance intact.
Meridian subscribers receive a renewal notice seven days before their next billing date.

cases.query: What do the independent inspection records say about whether test bench N7 was cleared for use on Tuesday?

sources.text: Tuesday safety inspector's signed log: bench N7 passed its interlock check and was cleared for use at 14:00.
Tuesday quality auditor's independent signed log: bench N7 failed its interlock check and remained out of service through close.
Bench N7 has a calibration appointment next month.

cases.query: Which pier should the field team use for the Saturday ride back from Birch Island?

sources.text: Archived dispatch draft: Saturday field-team return pickup at Birch Island's West Pier. Dispatch marked this issue superseded and removed it from the active packet.
Dispatch's issued correction: Saturday's field-team return pickup is at Birch Island's East Pier. This replaces the earlier West Pier instruction.
The Saturday morning supply run lands at Birch Island's West Pier.

cases.query: Why did the committee select the Riverside proposal?

sources.text: Committee-approved public award notice: Riverside offered the earliest installation date and included two years of maintenance.
Committee chair's restricted minutes, available only to voting members: a confidential reference raised concerns about the runner-up and influenced deliberations.
The public bid opening for Riverside was held on May 12. Four proposals were received.

cases.query: Where should the evening crew pick up the loaner scanner?

sources.text: Equipment custodian's handoff note, shared with the evening crew for this shift: collect the loaner scanner from the dispatch desk.
When the evening shift ends, return the loaner scanner to the charging cabinet.

cases.query: What kept the Harbor release on hold?

sources.text: Release owner's canonical register, approved for both providers: Harbor was held pending a signed rollback rehearsal.
Operations incident note, shared by its owner with fixture-a only: the Harbor rollback rehearsal stalled when the standby node refused promotion, leaving the release hold in effect.
Harbor's release digest lists the packages included in the candidate build and their checksums.
